title: Robin's Muhammara (Red Pepper Dip)
description: Muhammara is a Middle Eastern walnut and roasted red pepper dip that is savory, slightly sweet, smoky, and mildly spicy. Great as a dip, spread, or mezze dish.

steps.instruction: Add all ingredients to a food processor.
Process until smooth but slightly textured.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Add more breadcrumbs if the mixture is too watery.
